defs.def: a connection between two or more people or things 联系；连接

ex.s: People often link their memory of what they’ve read to how far into the book it was or where it was on the page.
ex.t: 人们常把对所读内容的记忆与它出现在书中的位置或页面上的位置联系起来。

ex.s: Why do we dream？Scientists aren't completely sure,and they have diverse____11____ (idea)．Dreams might be a side effect of memory making.When you sleep,your brain sorts through everything ____12____ happened during the day，trying to link new experiences to old memories.As it ____13____ (connect) things，your brain tums them into a story,and you get a dream．
ex.t: 我们为什么会做梦？科学家也不完全确定，他们有各种各样的___11___（想法）。梦可能是记忆形成的副作用。当你睡觉时，大脑会梳理白天发生的每一件事___12___，试图把新经历和旧记忆联系起来。当它___13___（连接）事物时，大脑把它们变成了一个故事，于是你便做了个梦。

ex.s: By linking its definitions to Addie’s situations.
ex.t: 通过将其定义与艾迪的处境联系起来。

ex.s: While the Internet is a worldwide network of computers linked by cables and satellites, the wood wide web is linked underground by fungi.
ex.t: 互联网是通过电缆和卫星连接的全世界的计算机网络，而木质万维网是通过真菌在地下连接的。

ex.s: Using the “wood wide web” •This fungal network links 7____________.
ex.t: 使用木质万维网：这种真菌网络连接着植物的根系。

ex.s: （2）A strong link is found between two species when a predator     ．
ex.t: （2）当捕食者___时，两个物种间会发现强联系。

ex.s: Emerging research suggests that courses in lower-ranked universities, on average, scored higher on teaching than courses in higher-ranked universities. ____37____ The absence of teaching excellence from the rankings is surprising given the link between high-quality teaching and student success.
ex.t: 新兴研究表明，平均而言，排名较低大学的课程在教学方面的得分高于排名较高的大学。____37____ 考虑到高质量教学与学生成功之间的联系，排名中缺少教学质量这一点令人惊讶。

defs.def: a relationship between two or more people, countries or organizations 关系；纽带

ex.s: As I served the role of vital communication link, I was reminded of my desperate struggle to converse before I learned English.
ex.t: 当我担任重要的沟通桥梁角色时，我想起了自己在学会英语之前拼命试图交流的痛苦挣扎。

ex.s: Eugénie, feeling that she was about to be left alone in the world, came, as it were, nearer to her father, and clasped more tightly this last living link of affection.
ex.t: 欧也妮感到自己即将独自留在这个世界上，于是她，可以说是，更靠近她的父亲，更紧地抓住了这最后一条鲜活的情感纽带。

defs.def: a means of travelling or communicating between two places 交通路线；通讯手段
a place in an electronic document that is connected to another electronic document or to another part of the same document 链接

ex.s: D．The differences between weak and strong links in food webs．
ex.t: D．食物网中弱链接与强链接之间的差异。

ex.s: End your essay by linking your conclusion back to the essay title.
ex.t: 通过将您的结论链接回论文标题来结束您的论文。

ex.s: To obtain the article or chapter, click on the link provided in the email and log into your ILL account.
ex.t: 要获取该文章或章节，请点击邮件中提供的链接并登录你的馆际互借账户。

defs.def: each ring of a chain （链状物的）环，节，圈
to make a physical or electronic connection between one object, machine, place, etc. and another 把（物体、机器、地方等）连接起来

ex.s: Her final goal is to link the worlds of art and science back together: She believes that bringing the old recipes to life can help develop a kind of learning that highlights experimentation, teamwork, and problem solving.
ex.t: 她的最终目标是把艺术与科学这两个世界重新联系起来：她相信，让古老配方“活”起来，有助于发展一种强调实验、团队合作和解决问题的学习方式。

ex.s: Linking arms with one of the instructors，I helped   51   the young man out of the water.
ex.t: 我挽着一位教练的胳膊，帮忙把那个年轻人____51____拉出水面。

ex.s: This fungal network links the roots of different plants to each other.
ex.t: 这种真菌网络将不同植物的根系相互连接起来。

ex.s: Volunteering during teenage years has been linked to some major positive effects such as improved grades and increased self-confidence.
ex.t: 希望能给一些有才华的演员留下印象，让他们愿意免费为我工作，我在沙发上铺了一些毯子，点上蜡烛，让它看起来更像"年轻专业人士"的风格。

defs.def: if sth links two things, facts or situations, or they are linked, they are connected in some way 联系；相关联

ex.s: Some scents are linked to cultural heritage.
ex.t: 最近的一项研究报告称，秘鲁的原住民社区注意到亚马逊河的气味因工业污染而发生了变化。

ex.s: It is closely linked to the steam age.
ex.t: 它与蒸汽时代密切相关。

defs.def: to state that there is a connection or relationship between two things or people 说明（两件东西或两人之间）有联系（或关系）

ex.s: Johnson has also investigated the link between well-being and certain story themes.
ex.t: 约翰逊还调查了幸福感与某些故事主题之间的联系。

ex.s: To show the link between storms and moisture.
ex.t: 为了展示风暴与水分之间的联系。

ex.s: “It can bring a new interest and focus into people’s lives and help to make the link between home and nature.”
ex.t: 它能给人们的生活带来新的兴趣和焦点，并帮助建立家与自然之间的联系。

ex.s: Researchers have found that there is a direct link between the increase in food eaten outside the home and the rise in   64  (weigh) problems.
ex.t: 研究人员发现，在家外就餐的增加与___64___（weigh）问题的上升之间有直接联系。

defs.def: to join two things by putting one through the other 挽住；钩住；套在一起
